textureSources.mapping: Photo pixels map at6.425px/mm around optical center394,400; projection restricted to actual source PCB top triangles atZ5.752mm. Raised Stamp module, connector blocks, screw/grommet areas excluded. Geometry clipping prevents any photograph outside source board outline.
textureSources.uncertainty: Frontal product photograph; camera and board-plane perspective remain approximate. Source800×800, board ROI260×372; no invented high resolution.

textureSources.mapping: Original paper pixels on an independent17.6×23.2mm carrier within18×24mm cover. Source cap has apertures and embossing, so projecting only onto its top triangles would incorrectly expose a giant M5 logo through the paper.

Four source bore centers rectify the original800px back photo onto carrier underside Z4.252mm. Source quad reverses X to match back UV. Raised optical module, motor plugs, wires and frame crossmembers are masked out; source face triangles clip the outer board.
textureSources.uncertainty: Uncalibrated color and remaining camera/component-height error. Rectified pixels retain approximately the original6.5px/mm; no fabricated detail.

textureSources.mapping: Original back photograph of optical-flow board on13.2×21.6mm separate carrier atZ-7.97, within its outline. Back UV mirrors X; hidden inward face is UNKNOWN.
textureSources.uncertainty: Native84×138px crop; thickness/depth and optical component height remain photograph estimates, not manufacturing CAD.

limitations: Ecosystem STL is a simplified simulator assembly, not manufacturer production CAD; source provenance before the Ecosystem publication is unverified.
Measured frame envelope81.842mm differs from official81.5mm. Published model is never rescaled to conceal this deviation.

Carrier PCB uses native source planes with separate masked front/back photographs; optical-flow daughterboard outline and seating are photo estimates on a separate plane. UNKNOWN marks its unobserved inward face, not a reconstructed electronic layout.
Four-blade propeller outlines, screw heads and connector inserts are photo-derived visual geometry. Blade pitch, threads, hidden fittings and contact fit are unverified.
Source propeller disks are retained in the combined source STL but omitted from display; official K138 photos show four blades, not three.
Photo colors include lighting and are not calibrated reflectance; PCB stays black under shell appearance presets.
No firmware execution, rotor RPM calibration, flight dynamics or physical hardware validation is established by these visual assets.

Optical-flow daughterboard thickness and seating depth are estimated±1.5mm; component heights, lens geometry and motor wires remain unmodeled. Source battery/board clearance is not a manufacturing fit check.
